note: ear roots v1 (2026-10-13), for earroot_v1_post.py / earroot_v1_field.py, appended after P-neck3. Anatomy review 2026-10-13, finding 10 (Nick, 2026-10-13: "Yes, fix all ten of them."): the back of each ear met the skull in a tight concave fillet (normal turning about 60 degrees within .03 at |x| about .19 to .21, y about .025, z .60 to .84), so the ear's back read as a flat plate set onto the skull. closing: a morphological closing of radius r (dilated surface as a projected point cloud) rounds that valley to radius r; fill only, so the thin ear blade, rim, convex skull and inner ear cup are unchanged; fillSigma smooths its quantization; smooth: a light fill-only blur of the result takes out the kink left at the old crease. masks: one ellipsoid per side at the rear ear root, times a rear-facing gate (rearGate on the y component of the field's unit normal) so only backward-facing surface takes the fill. Mask kept at z .5725 and above, clear of the jaw, throat and nape. Development variants a to n in untracked anatomy-fixes/work/10-earroot/specs (this is variant l). World units, +y back.
